spec.name: Halloween Uninvited Guest
spec.description: An original Orange SMP spectral guest with a hollow violet hood, recessed amber eyes, drooping sleeves and an uneven, open-bottom cloak. Static axis-aligned geometry preserves dark facial negative space and gaps between hanging tatters.

prompt: Creepy tall dark violet hooded spectral guest with small glowing amber eyes and tattered cloak, restrained vanilla horror, no gore. Static connected cuboids x,z0..16 y0..24. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
